title: Check the sequence, not only the parts
statement: Check a sequence of texts or lessons as a whole: a fact must agree from one to the next, and true steps must not misteach in the order given.
example: A continuity review of 2 consecutive lessons found one place put on the way to an island in the first and on the island in the second.
detail: A factuality ledger for four informational texts asks its independent check to sign the causal model they build, not only the separate claims: no step of the chain, as sequenced across the four texts, may misteach the standard account (`grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/02-factuality-claims.md`, fc-32). A continuity review of two consecutive lessons, run over the raw lesson data, found a place that the first lesson put on the flight path to an island and the second showed as part of the island, a factual story-world inconsistency it rated minor (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/readiness-l5-2026-09-17/sim-review/lens-arc-continuity.md`). Checking each text or lesson only one at a time is not enough.

evidence.quote: QC should sign the MODEL, not only the atoms: confirm no step of the chain as sequenced across texts 01->04 misteaches the standard account.
This is a factual story-world inconsistency.
(2) Part 1 stages all three Darling children rising together while the canonical passage and L4 p10 FIND say Michael jumps first
Otherwise the video showed Penelope keeping people out and then, six seconds later, taught that keeping people out is the failure.
meadow "feeds plants" **contradicts the producer model** taught two atoms earlier
The video is the more accurate of the two and this is not the script's fault, but a child meets both within a few minutes.
